lines.text: **Date:** 2026-10-17. **Status:** proposed extensions; none of the new exports claimed shipped. **Branch:** main. **Canonical program:** [Adaptive Computation and Control](https://github.com/jehalladay/FiberOpticsResearch/tree/main/docs/research/foa/programs/adaptive-computation-and-control-2026-10-17). **Work packages:** AC-01, AC-04, AC-10, AC-15.

ActivityBoundary ACTIVE/WARM/DORMANT/EVICTED remains separate from QueryView identity and speculative execution ownership. A warm context may precompute only explicitly eligible read-only resources under existing SpeculationBoundary, not call inference/effects. Add tests TSX-RQ1 five-stage TestHealth, TSX-RQ2 ready UNKNOWN vs pending, TSX-RQ3 aborted attempt no registration, TSX-RQ4 query spec scope changes stable hook order, TSX-RQ5 two consumers share one host query view without premature unsubscribe, TSX-RQ6 TS/Python golden, TSX-RQ7 existing ADR-0032 no premature optimizer or component skipping. DevTools only consumes emitted host events.

triage.text: - Statement: The shared ADR (next free number per docs/adr/README.md:46-51) MUST define the Activity states ACTIVE/WARM/DORMANT/EVICTED exactly once and MUST record the host as the lifecycle owner, the SDK declaring an ActivityBoundary and reading a status (ruling R-03); ActivityBoundary and SpeculationBoundary MUST be marked PROPOSED (0 files at db7558552).
